en.headline: Police arrest 44-year-old minibus driver over suspected drug driving with passengers
en.dek: Officers stopped a route 117B minibus in Sau Mau Ping after a tailing operation; the driver tested positive for methamphetamine and seven passengers were removed safely.
body: Police arrested a 44-year-old local minibus driver on Tuesday on suspicion of driving after taking methamphetamine while carrying passengers.

Senior Inspector Pun Chun-ho of the Kowloon East traffic division said officers launched a targeted operation after intelligence pointed to a driver on the Yau Tong to Anderson route. They identified a 117B minibus at the Domain Mall terminus and followed it. The vehicle was stopped on On Yu Road in Sau Mau Ping.

Seven passengers were on board at the time and were removed from the vehicle without injury. A rapid oral fluid test indicated the driver had taken methamphetamine before driving. Police found no drugs on the vehicle. The man was arrested and denied bail. He is due to appear at Kwun Tong Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday.

Police said the case followed earlier arrests of public transport drivers in June, some of whom had already been convicted and sentenced to imprisonment and driving disqualifications. They described drug driving by public transport operators as a serious threat to passenger and road-user safety.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕44歲小巴司機涉載客時毒後駕駛
zh.dek: 人員尾隨一輒117B專線小巴至秀茂坪截停，司機口腔液測試呈冰毒陽性，車上7名乘客被安全帶離。
body: 警方周二拘捕一名44歲本地小巴司機，涉嫌在載客期間毒後駕駛。
東九龍總區交通部執行及管制組高級督察潘俊豪表示，警方根據情報展開針對性行動，鎖定一輊來往油塘至安達臣的專線小巴司機。人員在油塘Domain商場小巴總站識別目標117B小巴後展開尾隨，最終在秀茂坪安愉道將車輛截停。
截停時車上有7名乘客，全部安然無恙並被安全帶離車廂。司機接受快速口腔液測試，結果顯示他駕駛前曾吸食冰毒。警方在車上未有檢獲毒品。該名男子被拘捕後不准保釋，將於周三在觀塘裁判法院提堂。
警方指，今次行動延續今年6月針對公共服務車輛司機的執法，當時有司機已被定罪並判處監禁及停牌。警方強調，公共交通司機毒後駕駛對乘客及其他道路使用者構成嚴重威脅。
